name: video_rotate
description: Rotate a video by 90 (clockwise), 180 or 270/-90 (counter-clockwise) degrees and/or mirror it. Use it to fix sideways phone videos or mirrored webcam recordings. The picture is re-encoded, so it plays correctly in every player.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

flip.description: Mirror the picture: none (default), horizontal, vertical or both.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_rotated.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
